summary: Screening DANGCEM

plan the screen

We will commence by cross-referencing Dangote Cement Plc’s 10‑K business description against Shariah-prohibited activity thresholds, then pull SEC-filing metrics (cash, receivables, total assets, revenue, interest income, debt) via Zetaris to compute the AAOIFI and MSCI Islamic Index financial ratios. Purification amounts, if any, will be calculated per the prevailing standard.
